prompt_en: A photographic LitRPG scene in which RPG rules are visible inside the lived fantasy world. A fantasy artisan and customer share a cold glassworking counter, where an item appraisal changes a purchase decision. The fictional woman maker has a face and short dark bob with fine fringe guided by the supplied reference portrait. Her identity, occupation and circumstances belong to this fictional scene. At the shutter she has just finished a blue glass lantern vial for a marsh surveyor before his morning departure. What looked like a trapped white flaw proves useful in dense marsh fog. She steadies the cooled vial by its broad foot with the thumb and index finger of her left hand, her wrist extending naturally from the forearm resting along the stone counter. Her other hand rests beside a copper glassworking rod. The customer stands across the right end of the counter, shoulders and both forearms visible; his right fingers set three silver coins onto a small leather payment square while his gaze follows the vial and its appraisal. A folded marsh map protrudes from his satchel. Her quiet confidence and the customer's slightly raised brows make the small revaluation readable. The vial occupies a clear central space between their hands. A restrained translucent appraisal card floats directly above it; its readable item statistics point to that same physical item by a thin line ending at the white seed inside the glass. The card is one complete item status sheet: an identity header "LANTERN VIAL" with "UNCOMMON" beneath it, clearly labeled attribute rows "MIST SIGHT +12" and "VALUE 18 SILVER", and a visibly separate resource block "CHARGE 6/6" showing current and maximum charge. The header sits above the attribute rows, while a narrow divider separates those rows from the lower resource block. A smaller separate badge beside the maker's apron reads "GLASSCRAFT Lv.7" and "XP 84/100", visibly assigning the craft progression to her. The glass transmits cool daylight while its trapped seed gives a restrained amber glimmer. A cutting collar, glass shears and a cooling rack place the transaction in a working craft shop; the furnace opening is a low warm patch in the rear. Use a landscape medium view from the near corner of the counter, a normal lens and sufficient depth to resolve both faces, hands, the vial and full appraisal card together. The glassblower's open-neck ivory linen work blouse and weathered brown waist apron catch soft window light; subtle skin texture, luminous eyes and an unforced expression carry her personal appeal. Warm furnace color recedes behind the cool precise glass. Grounded photographic material, an intimate but practical working distance, and a clear hierarchy from maker's expression to the vial to the buyer's payment.

h_f2_material_decisions.rationale: The source supplies an in-frame counter customer for a human interaction. Baseline/A1 retain the independently authored customer rather than attributing it to retrieval. See source-review.json and composition-comparison.md.

A single completed glass vial appraisal is neither a paired conversion test nor an alchemist process. Extracting only the word comparison would erase its distinctive endpoints. Declined; no qualified source owner or complete transformation context was independently frozen. See source-review.json and composition-comparison.md.

Declined whole source rather than borrowing the role label. See source-review.json and composition-comparison.md.

No distinct refinement owed. See source-review.json and composition-comparison.md.

I01 describes a complete generic information structure: one status sheet, an identity header above labeled attribute rows, and a separate resource block showing current/maximum. A1 retains all these parts and relations on the same item card: "LANTERN VIAL"/"UNCOMMON" header, "MIST SIGHT +12" and "VALUE 18 SILVER" rows, separate "CHARGE 6/6" block below a divider. These are independently justified generic UI attributes on open text/composition, not a distinctive qualified native cue. No native adoption/guard/owner authority is asserted. Compared with the undifferentiated baseline card, the resource and value distinctions make the displayed rule system more explicit at a modest text cost. Pixel gate B6 requires every part together. Final use is inspiration_only; causal image improvement remains unproven. See source-review.json and composition-comparison.md.

See source-review.json and composition-comparison.md.
